info.name: KLSM Affiliate
info.description:
API sistem afiliasi admin (SQLite + DuckDB). Jalankan folder berurutan: Owner Auth → Config → Admins → Ingest → ... Variabel (mapKey, adminId, eventId, dll) diisi otomatis oleh test script.

Auth:
- Owner: cookie session (login dulu, Postman simpan cookie otomatis)
- Game: header x-map-key
- Webhook: header x-webhook-secret
- Admin: cookie session terpisah (folder Admin Auth)

item.name: 1 · Owner Auth
item.description: Cookie klsm_session disimpan otomatis oleh Postman setelah login.

request.description: bps = basis point. 1000 = 10%. effectiveFrom null = sekarang. Berlaku ke depan saja.
ingestKey hanya muncul sekali. Test script menyimpannya ke variabel mapKey.

exec: const setv = (k, v) => { pm.collectionVariables.set(k, v); try { pm.environment.set(k, v); } catch (e) {} };
const j = pm.response.json(); setv("mapKey", j.ingestKey); setv("mapId", j.map.id); console.log("mapKey disimpan:", j.ingestKey);
